subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan for HelioSync
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Ross <evan.ross@heliosync.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan for HelioSync

Hi Evan — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side and a concrete POC proposal so we can lock next steps.

Demo highlights (what you called out):
- Entity extraction accuracy for medical device records (target: F1 >= 0.88)
- Endpoint latency requirements: tail latency < 600ms for 95th pct on 20 concurrent requests
- Data residency: primary processing in us-west region; sample data will be hosted on your S3

Proposed POC (4-week scoped trial):
1) Week 0 (kickoff): access & onboarding — share sample dataset, S3 read-only creds or presigned path, and test prompt set (you said ~2k rows)
2) Week 1: baseline run + quick model tuning (quantization profile we demoed)
3) Week 2: integration tests (latency/load, prefix caching enabled)
4) Week 3: evaluation against success criteria + handoff workshop

Success criteria (what we’ll measure):
- Extraction F1 >= 0.88 on the agreed labeled set
- 95th pct latency < 600ms under 20 concurrent users
- Integration sanity: <1% malformed responses for structured output schema

Ownership and asks:
- Commercial owner: me (Marcus Lin) — for scope/contract
- Customer success: Monica Patel (cc) — POC enablement and acceptance
- Solution engineering: we recommend looping Soojin (I’ll add her on follow-up) for the ingestion/runbook bits
- From HelioSync: please share the sample dataset, the test prompt set, and the contact for your engineering lead (we discussed a possible invite for Nisha)

Attachments: redwood-poc-outline-v1.pdf (POC plan), soc2-summary-excerpt.pdf (security snapshot)

Proposed kickoff dates: July 10 or July 12. If either works, we’ll send a calendar invite and a short mutual action plan doc.

Would you confirm the success criteria above and which kickoff date you prefer?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

---
From: Evan Ross <evan.ross@heliosync.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Jul 2028 09:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan for HelioSync

Marcus — thanks for the clear write-up. Helpful. A few clarifications from our side before we lock dates: 

1) Success criteria: the F1 target looks right, but on the latency side we need to make sure 600ms is realistic at 20 conc — can you confirm if that includes model cold starts and if KV/prefix caching will be active during the test?
2) Security: before we share the sensitive sample set we need a short SOC2 excerpt and confirmation about encryption at rest and transit. You attached a summary but can you point to a concrete doc or provide an HLD?
3) Team: I’ll loop in Nisha Patel (Engineering Lead) — she’ll validate the S3 access model. Expect her on the kickoff invite.

Tentative kickoff: July 12 works better for our engineering calendar. We’ll share a sanitized sample dataset (PII removed) and an S3 presigned path by EOD Monday.

Also — please include a short SOW draft (even a one-page attachment) that we can circulate internally for budget hold.

Thanks,
Evan Ross
Head of Data Science
HelioSync
evan.ross@heliosync.com

Monica / Soojin — forwarding Evan’s reply. TL;DR: HelioSync is good with a July 12 kickoff, they need SOC2 excerpt + a one-page SOW, and they’ll add Nisha (eng lead).

Proposed internal owner actions: 
- Marcus (me): finalize commercial terms and SOW draft, circulate to Evan — target SOW v0 by Mon 07/03 EOD
- Monica: lead the onboarding/acceptance plan and coordinate weekly check-ins during the POC
- Soojin: lead the integration checklist (S3 ingestion method, sample dataset validation, run perf tests for 20 concurrent reqs) and confirm feasibility of 95th pct <600ms with prefix caching enabled

Attachments included for internal reference: sow-draft-heliosync.docx (placeholder), soc2-summary-excerpt.pdf

Can you both confirm and I’ll drop the SOW draft into Drive and send to Evan. Also, Soojin — any initial notes on load profile or infra we should prep before kickoff?

Marcus

From: Evan Ross <evan.ross@heliosync.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Marcus / Monica — confirming July 12 kickoff works for us. Nisha is the engineering lead for the POC and will own the S3 creds exchange. We will: 
- Share a presigned S3 path with ~2k sanitized rows by Monday 07/09
- Provide a short list of validation examples (attached inline) for the extraction labels

Evan attached a short checklist and requested items:
- SOC2 excerpt (we received the PDF, thanks)
- One-page SOW — please send via DocuSign when ready; finance needs a document to hold budget

Also shared: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/HLX-2028-1482 (HelioSync deal record) — I’ll update pipeline once we have the SOW.

Next actions: 
- Marcus: drop SOW v0 in Drive and circulate for DocuSign by Mon 07/03
- Soojin: prepare a short perf-run checklist and estimate infra footprint (GPU / concurrency config)
- Monica: draft the acceptance test plan and weekly check-in cadence (30m x 4 weeks)

Thanks — looking forward to kicking this off.

Best,
Evan Ross
Head of Data Science, HelioSync
ev an.ross@heliosync.com
